steps.action: Open a browser capsule from the pinned arm64 package
steps.outcome: Capsule window created; the operator keeps the desktop keyboard

steps.action: Sign in to the disposable demo account manually
steps.outcome: Login completed by the operator; credentials stay in the capsule

steps.action: Attempt agent input while login is active
steps.outcome: Refused by LOGIN_ACTIVE; no keystroke or click is forwarded

steps.outcome: Control lease granted; the operator can reclaim with one move

steps.action: Receive a Gemini plan for the frozen demo task
steps.outcome: Four proposed steps observed; the plan is advisory and does not execute

steps.outcome: Pending Deep Research state observed; completion is not claimed

steps.action: Rename and navigate the disposable conversation
steps.outcome: Rename and navigation observed on disposable content

steps.action: Stop the capsule and restart the supported workflow
steps.outcome: Clean stop and restart observed; no orphaned surface is claimed
